name: Release Automation

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    name: Build & Publish GitHub Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
        with:
          packages: |
            platform-tools
            cmdline-tools;latest
            platforms;android-34
            platforms;android-35
            build-tools;34.0.0
            build-tools;35.0.0

      - name: Verify Android SDK & Build Tools
        run: |
          echo "ANDROID_HOME: $ANDROID_HOME"
          echo "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT: $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
          ls -la "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms"
          ls -la "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools"

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # 1. Compile Standalone Release APK & Prepare Asset
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Compile Standalone Release APK (app/build.sh)
        run: |
          echo "=== Compiling Standalone Reproducible Release APK ==="
          chmod +x app/build.sh
          ./app/build.sh
          test -f app-release.apk || { echo "ERROR: app-release.apk not found after build!" >&2; exit 1; }
          cp app-release.apk opentv.apk
          test -f opentv.apk || { echo "ERROR: opentv.apk not found!" >&2; exit 1; }

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # 2. Multi-Scheme Signature Verification (v1, v2, v3)
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Verify APK Signatures with apksigner
        run: |
          echo "=== Verifying APK Multi-Scheme Signature (v1, v2, v3) ==="
          test -f opentv.apk || { echo "ERROR: opentv.apk not found!" >&2; exit 1; }
          BT=$(find "${ANDROID_HOME:-$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT}/build-tools" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d | sort -V | tail -n 1)
          test -x "$BT/apksigner" || { echo "ERROR: apksigner not found at $BT/apksigner" >&2; exit 1; }
          VERIFY_OUTPUT=$("$BT/apksigner" verify --verbose opentv.apk)

          echo "$VERIFY_OUTPUT" | grep -q "Verified using v2 scheme (APK Signature Scheme v2): true" || { echo "ERROR: v2 signature missing!" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "$VERIFY_OUTPUT" | grep -q "Verified using v3 scheme (APK Signature Scheme v3): true" || { echo "ERROR: v3 signature missing!" >&2; exit 1; }
          echo "SUCCESS: All signature schemes (v1, v2, v3) verified."

      # 3. APK Footprint Ceiling Enforcement (< 60 KB)
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Enforce Release APK Footprint Ceiling (< 60 KB)
        run: |
          echo "=== Enforcing Release APK Footprint Ceiling (< 60 KB / 61,440 bytes) ==="

          test -s opentv.apk || { echo "ERROR: opentv.apk is empty (0 bytes)!" >&2; exit 1; }
          APK_SIZE=$(stat -c%s opentv.apk 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z opentv.apk 2>/dev/null)
          test -n "$APK_SIZE" && [ "$APK_SIZE" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: Failed to determine valid APK size: '$APK_SIZE'" >&2; exit 1; }
          MAX_SIZE=61440 # 60 * 1024 bytes
          echo "Release APK Size: $APK_SIZE bytes (ceiling: $MAX_SIZE bytes / 60 KB)"
          if [ "$APK_SIZE" -gt "$MAX_SIZE" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Release APK size ($APK_SIZE bytes) exceeds strict 60 KB limit ($MAX_SIZE bytes)!" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "SUCCESS: Release APK ($APK_SIZE bytes) is within the 60 KB footprint limit."

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # 4. Package Standalone Companion Archive
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

        run: |
          echo "=== Packaging Standalone Companion Archive (opentv-companion.tar.gz) ==="

          if [ -d scripts ]; then

          tar --exclude="__pycache__" --exclude="*.pyc" -czf opentv-companion.tar.gz $FILES
          test -f opentv-companion.tar.gz || { echo "ERROR: opentv-companion.tar.gz not found!" >&2; exit 1; }

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # 5. Compute SHA256 Checksums
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Compute Release Asset SHA256 Checksums
        run: |
          echo "=== Computing SHA256 Checksums for Release Assets ==="
          sha256sum opentv.apk opentv-companion.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS.txt
          test -f SHA256SUMS.txt || { echo "ERROR: SHA256SUMS.txt not created!" >&2; exit 1; }
          test -s SHA256SUMS.txt || { echo "ERROR: SHA256SUMS.txt is empty!" >&2; exit 1; }
          cat SHA256SUMS.txt

          echo "SUCCESS: Release asset checksums computed and verified."

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # 6. Upload Action Artifacts (Run Archive)
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Upload Release Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: opentv-release-assets
          path: |
            opentv.apk
            opentv-companion.tar.gz
            SHA256SUMS.txt
          if-no-files-found: error

      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # 7. Publish GitHub Release
      # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Publish GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        with:
          files: |
            opentv.apk
            opentv-companion.tar.gz
            SHA256SUMS.txt
          generate_release_notes: true
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
